name: dota-observer-studio
description: Desktop app for building Dota 2 spectator stream overlays.
author: oskarij

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:overlay && npm run build:electron
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && npm run build:overlay && npm run build:electron && electron .
scripts.test:unit: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test build/test/tests/gsiSelection.test.js build/test/tests/playerProfiles.test.js build/test/tests/observers.test.js build/test/tests/httpServer.test.js build/test/tests/selectedPlayerFormat.test.js build/test/tests/knownPlayersCsv.test.js build/test/tests/networkRebind.test.js
scripts.typecheck: svelte-kit sync && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.overlay.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
